changes.initial_review: SEH can leave call_cpu_function without reaching its old trailing interface_active reset; finally preserves cleanup on ordinary and abnormal paths.
changes.counter_review: A stale active flag routes later CPU faults to abandoned interface_abort. Guest fault longjmp and ordinary return still reset active; SEH propagates rather than fabricating success. Original single global frame remains a separate reentry limitation, not repaired by finally.
changes.limits: Source and fixture inspection only; no fresh run, universal reachability or full logical-line proof.
changes.change_plan: Keep try/finally around original call body; preserve interface_error return for guest fault and allow native exception propagation. Do not create a second interface state machine.
changes.verification_required: Existing actual-source callback-abort fixture: native SEH clears active, next guest fault returns13, next normal call succeeds. Real WOW callback abort and parent resumption; nested reentry not inferred from these controls.
